screen.wateroptimisation.title: Water Optimisation
screen.wateroptimisation.description: Makes water cheaper to draw on your computer. Your world, gameplay, and servers are never changed.
screen.wateroptimisation.enabled.descrip: The main switch. Turn it off to get normal Minecraft water back instantly.
screen.wateroptimisation.profile_descrip: Everything off. Water looks and works exactly like normal Minecraft.
Water looks exactly the same. Only water particles more than 32 blocks away are hidden.
Recommended. Skips water you can't see and turns off water particles. Visible water looks the same.
Fastest. Also draws less of the water's inside, so water can look different while you're underwater.
You've changed settings on the Water or Particles tab. Pick a preset or press Reset to start over.
screen.wateroptimisation.reset.descripti: Undoes your changes on the Water and Particles tabs and goes back to the selected preset.
screen.wateroptimisation.diagnostics.des: Shows a small on-screen panel counting skipped water and particles. Handy for comparing presets; leave it off for normal play.
screen.wateroptimisation.fast_path.descr: Skips water blocks that are completely covered, like deep inside an ocean. You can't see them, so nothing looks different. Safe to leave on.
screen.wateroptimisation.reduced_faces.d: Experimental. Skips the back side of water surfaces. Faster in big oceans, but water can look odd while you're underwater or looking through glass.
screen.wateroptimisation.particles.descr: Bubbles, splashes, and drips. Turning them off saves the most.
screen.wateroptimisation.particle_distan: Water particles farther away than this are hidden. Lower is faster.
screen.wateroptimisation.fog.description: Also hides water particles that are mostly lost in fog anyway.
screen.wateroptimisation.particle_budget: Caps how many new water particles can appear at once. Helps in heavy rain or near big waterfalls.
screen.wateroptimisation.forced_particle: The game or a server can mark some particles as "always show". On: they follow your particle settings too. Off: they always appear.
screen.wateroptimisation.sodium_notice: Sodium is installed and draws water itself, so the options below are unavailable. Particle settings still work.
screen.wateroptimisation.note.unsupporte: Not available on this Minecraft version.
screen.wateroptimisation.note.needs_part: Turn on Water particles to change this.
screen.wateroptimisation.note.nothing_to: Nothing to reset: your settings already match the preset.
screen.wateroptimisation.note.mod_off: Water Optimisation is turned off, so the preset isn't doing anything.
screen.wateroptimisation.note.inactive_o: Water Optimisation is turned off. These settings will work once you turn it on in the General tab.
screen.wateroptimisation.note.inactive_v: The Vanilla preset keeps everything off. Pick another preset in the General tab to use these settings.
wateroptimisation.path.hidden_compile: skipping hidden water, with particle limits
wateroptimisation.path.reduced_faces: drawing less inside water, with particle limits
wateroptimisation.path.sodium_particles: Sodium draws the water; particle limits active
